description: Quad LFO: four simple LFOs that can run free or be locked to one another by ratio, quadrature, phase or spread

params.text: Sets the rate of that LFO; in every mode but Independent only the first of these knobs sets a rate, and the other three set a frequency ratio, an amplitude or a phase offset as the mode dictates.
Bends the shape of that LFO, and does something different for each shape; in Random Trigger mode it sets the chance that the value changes.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.
Chooses how the four LFOs relate: Independent, Rate Ratio, Quadrature, Phase Offset or Entangled.

inputs.text: A trigger restarts that LFO in Independent mode; in every other mode it restarts all four at once.
A trigger restarts that LFO in Independent mode; in every other mode this jack takes the clock the four LFOs sync to.
A trigger restarts that LFO in Independent mode; in every other mode a high gate here freezes all four where they stand.
A trigger restarts that LFO in Independent mode; in every other mode a trigger here runs all four backwards.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

outputs.text: Carries that LFO, 5V either way, or 0-10V when it is set to unipolar.

notes: An LFO's shape is set from its strip in the display area, not the module menu: clicking the name opens the eight shapes plus Unipolar (0/10v) and Bipolar (-5/+5v).
A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Polyphony — a submenu carrying Follow Trigger Input and a channel count from 1 to 16.
Clock in QuarterNotes — reads the clock input as a quarter-note trigger, and the panel labels that jack CLOCK.
Clock in BPM CV — reads the clock input as a tempo voltage, and the panel labels that jack BPM.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
